_what: What a tool or package may be declared to need, and which privileged calls each need unlocks (src/manifest-permissions.mjs). `permissions` are rows (a new one is a row): its id, what it lets a package do, and the `calls` of the host API it gates. A manifest naming a permission with no row is refused; a call that a row gates is refused unless the manifest named that permission. `entry` rules keep a manifest's entry file inside its own package folder.

permissions.says: Write or delete files on this computer
Read what is on the screen

words.unknown_permission: The manifest asks for {names}, which this host has no permission row for.
words.not_granted: {call} needs the permission {permission}, which the manifest did not declare.
words.escapes: The entry {entry} is outside its package folder.
words.not_declared: {call} is not a call this host gates, so it is not available to packages.
